findings.finding: Governed change records and retained worktrees were split between active and historical containers, making closeout state depend on location.
findings.resolution: Normalized the invariant: governed records remain in .work/changes and retained worktrees in .work/worktrees regardless of active/closed state; work-layout is deterministically checked pre-CI and CI.

findings.finding: The restructure removed tracked paths and left stale durable evidence references.
findings.resolution: Promoted required issue-195 evidence, converted genuine historical identities to git-history references, broadened durable-reference verification, and confirmed zero live non-historical references to the 346 deleted tracked paths.

findings.finding: Repository Python execution and first-party CI did not consistently enforce the active worktree-local .venv boundary.
findings.resolution: CI/bootstrap semantics were clarified and all repository Python/tool execution now uses the checkout-local .venv after bootstrap; deterministic boundary verifier and regression tests added.

findings.finding: The restructure risked losing executable capabilities while moving or retiring modules, tests, scripts, workflows, and research artifacts.
findings.resolution: Restored required current capabilities, retained non-authoritative history under .work, confirmed zero live deleted-path dependencies, and import-smoke-tested all 44 commodity modules successfully.

findings.finding: Frozen V1 CSV load lost the original index name while integrity hashing still passed.
findings.resolution: Freeze manifest records index_name and loader restores it; regression coverage added.

findings.finding: Frozen V1 CSV load could infer integer dtype for integer-valued float columns while integrity hashing still passed.
findings.resolution: Freeze manifest records column_dtypes and loader restores them; regression coverage added.

findings.finding: Dataset construction self-certified reconstruction and semantic correctness from a single build.
findings.resolution: A single build is provisional. Exact deterministic second reconstruction verifies reconstruction only; a separate explicit_dataset_semantics_v1 check is required before research-ready assurance.

findings.finding: Reusable dataset audit/freeze capability had been lost during restructure.
findings.resolution: Restored and adapted dataset audit/freeze modules and tests to current research_dataset authority, with immutable content/config/transformation identities and round-trip verification.

findings.finding: The old V1 freeze differs from the current roll-safe reconstruction and cannot be treated as current clean evidence.
findings.resolution: Preserved it as known defective legacy evidence (pre-roll-safe market predictors); it was not rewritten or blessed with current assurance.

findings.finding: Market-source authority was internally contradictory and contract frames could be implicitly attributed to the configured source rather than their actual source.
findings.resolution: databento_henry_hub is the configured canonical source; massive_henry_hub_evaluation is evaluation-only; contract datasets require explicit market_source_id and Massive cannot pass canonical promotion.

findings.finding: The retained Massive V1 canonical.csv was hash-verified but not reconstructed from retained raw contract/aggregate artifacts in the actual V1 build path.
findings.resolution: Added offline raw-archive replay. The retained 36-contract archive reconstructs all 11,200 canonical rows exactly; V1 now consumes the reconstructed table. New archives declare a replayable component-hash algorithm; legacy archives rely on artifact hashes, row counts, and exact raw-to-canonical equality because their obsolete pre-serialization hash cannot be reproduced from sorted JSON.

findings.finding: Deterministic replay was incorrectly sufficient to mark semantic correctness verified.
findings.resolution: Separated reconstruction and semantic gates; semantic checks are inspectable in the assurance contract and cryptographically bound by a semantic_validation layer.

findings.finding: V1 assurance did not bind the raw Massive archive manifest or provider normalization/replay implementation used before generic dataset construction.
findings.resolution: V1 assurance now includes the retained market-archive manifest SHA-256 and binds full_v1 plus massive_futures_provider transformation hashes before reconstruction comparison.

findings.finding: A live assumption referenced a retired Lenovo specification as though it still existed in current docs.
findings.resolution: Converted it to explicit git-history evidence and broadened live machine-reference resolution checks.

findings.finding: Timezone-aware V1 bounds emitted timezone-drop warnings during NYISO month iteration.
findings.resolution: Month-bound conversion now removes timezone explicitly before period conversion; warning-as-error regression test added.

findings.finding: Several binding repository/data rules depended on convention rather than direct deterministic pre-CI verification.
findings.resolution: Added/wired deterministic checks for work layout, Python environment boundary, durable evidence references, market-source authority, and dataset assurance contract; generated rule-verification docs refreshed.

findings.finding: Rule wiring verification could accept a verifier name that appeared only in a non-executing comment or string-like line.
findings.resolution: Hardened rule wiring verification to require executable invocation evidence; regression coverage proves comment/string-only references fail.

findings.finding: The Python environment boundary did not detect raw version-qualified Python executables such as python3.11 or python3.12 as worktree-local .venv bypasses.
findings.resolution: Extended raw-Python detection to version-qualified executables and added failing-then-passing regression coverage.

findings.finding: Pre-CI whitespace verification checked only one Git diff surface and could miss whitespace defects in the other staged/unstaged surface.
findings.resolution: Canonical pre-CI verification now runs git diff --check for both unstaged and staged changes; regression coverage added.

findings.finding: Kronos forecast adapters accepted non-datetime history indices and passed them downstream as model timestamps instead of enforcing the adapter timestamp contract.
findings.resolution: Both Kronos adapters now fail closed unless history and forecast-horizon indices are DatetimeIndex values; a failing-then-passing regression covers both adapters.

findings.finding: Dataset semantic verification could accept unbound self-certified semantic booleans.
findings.resolution: Semantic assurance now requires source-bound explicit_dataset_semantics_v1 evidence; adversarial regression rejects unbound self-certification.

findings.finding: Canonical market metadata could disagree with the selected source authority.
findings.resolution: Canonical metadata is validated against configured source authority; adversarial regression rejects mismatched metadata.

findings.finding: Kronos forecast adapters could accept overlapping or backward forecast horizons.
findings.resolution: Both adapters fail closed on non-forward/non-disjoint forecast horizons; parameterized regression covers both adapters.

findings.finding: Forecast output could propagate non-finite predictor values.
findings.resolution: Forecast paths reject non-finite predictor output before downstream use; regression coverage added.

findings.finding: Enabled Kronos could run under a Python version incompatible with its governed runtime lock.
findings.resolution: Repository environment verification now fails closed when enabled Kronos runtime Python differs from the pinned lock; regression coverage added.

findings.finding: Rule-verification wiring could be satisfied by non-executing wrapper/comment/string references.
findings.resolution: Registry wiring requires executable invocation evidence; adversarial tests reject non-executing wrapper references.

findings.finding: Model confidence-set logic used a non-studentized comparison where studentized pairwise statistics were required.
findings.resolution: Confidence-set computation now uses studentized pairwise statistics; regression coverage fixes the intended statistical contract.

findings.finding: An opposite-sign replication could incorrectly promote programme evidence.
findings.resolution: Evidence derivation now blocks promotion when replication direction contradicts the registered effect; adversarial regression added.

findings.finding: Governed research preflight could proceed without the canonical registry.
findings.resolution: Research preflight now fails closed when canonical registry state is unavailable; regression coverage added.

findings.finding: Runtime programme ledger validation did not fully enforce the canonical JSON schema.
findings.resolution: Runtime ledger validation now enforces the canonical schema before use; adversarial regression added.

findings.finding: Whitespace enforcement missed committed-range defects and six new blank lines at EOF remained in the closure set.
findings.resolution: Six EOF whitespace defects were removed; pre-CI and CI now share check_git_whitespace.py covering staged, unstaged, and committed ranges. Fresh committed-head verification passed.

findings.finding: The prior Bundle 01 independent-review evidence was invalid and could not support closure.
findings.resolution: Replaced by three exact-head bounded independent reviews covering CI/whitespace, environment, and rule-registry scope; all completed with no surviving P0-P3 findings. Monolithic Codex/NVIDIA transport failures are recorded as diagnostics, not verdicts.
